start: All four runs from scratch; no extension of old curriculum checkpoints. Same flat level1 scenario selector and RNG seed142 for all runs.
epsilon: Unchanged: warmup1000; epsilon1 to0.1 over80000 steps after warmup; floor0.1 from81000. Per-decision Bernoulli gate.
state_dependency: Exploration distribution independent of observation and history, freshly sampled each decision. Greedy argmax depends on observation. No persistence, no extra policy state or replay state.
data_sources: Physical catalog only; no PID decisions, demonstrations, future information or test data. Training only existing128 L1 cases.
validation: Initial and every10k: greedy existing128 reserved cases (32 each L1/L2/L3/original), no update or RNG consumption. No final test.
checkpoint_rule: L1 max success fraction, then min mean absolute x of successful landings, then earliest; initial excluded.
comparison: Only replay capacity changes from the weighted 50k-capacity reference. Both algorithms fresh;100k each. Verify exact prefix through50000 before continuing. Passive exposure labels never affect sampling.
telemetry: Record mode from actual sampled gate, not from equality to argmax. Diagnostic labels never influence decisions. Histograms by mode, first success, retained successful terminal transitions, gas-empty and contact state.
